images.caption: Figure 1:GDPval Pass@1 comparison.Agent-R2-4B improves the Qwen3-4B-Thinking base model by 18.6 points and surpasses several larger open-source baselines.

Figure 2:Agent-R2data synthesis pipeline.The framework extracts file-oriented workflow blueprints from real web-corpus evidence, retrieves and verifies public attachments, and synthesizes instructions, rubrics, and references in sandbox.

Figure 3:Rubric-based RL training.Agent-R2samples multi-turn rollouts in sandbox, renders generated deliverables for MLLM-as-a-judge scoring against rubrics and references, and updates the policy with group advantages and KL regularization.

Figure 4:Model behavior and completion quality.Left: completion rate, average tool-call steps, and average tool-call errors across the base, SFT, and RL variants. Right: win/tie/loss outcomes of the RL-trained model against the SFT-only model after valid completion on GDPval, where green, orange, and gray segments indicate RL wins, ties, and SFT wins, respectively.

Figure 6:Case study of shortcut behavior in materials-test report generation.The base model and Gemini-2.5-Pro produce flawed reports from incomplete or invalid spreadsheet evidence, whereas Agent-R2-4B recovers from parsing and execution errors, computes the required values, and verifies the generated plots in the final PDF deliverable.
